message.content:
This is a combination microwave, air fryer, and toaster oven for domestic use. Microwave ovens fall under 8516.50 and are classified there. Other electrothermic ovens fall under 8516.60. Because the unit's multiple functions are combined in one housing, GRI 3(b) applies, and the essential character is arguably the microwave function.

The 8516.50 subheading is "Microwave ovens", and its statistical suffix is 8516.50.0000. 8516.60 covers "Other ovens; cookers, cooking plates, boiling rings, grillers and roasters", and its toaster-oven suffix is 8516.60.4060 or similar.

CBP has ruled on combination microwave/air fryer ovens. I recall rulings placing them in 8516.50.0000 when the microwave function gives the essential character. Here the name "Macrowave" and the microwave being listed first support that choice.
